The motion satisfies \(m\frac{dv}{dt}=mg-0.2v\) giving \(v(t)=V_t(1-e^{-kt})\) with terminal speed \(V_t=mg/0.2=12.25\;\text{m/s}\) and \(k=0.2/m=0.8\;\text{s}^{-1}\). Solving the distance integral \(x=V_t\big[t+\frac{1}{k}(e^{-kt}-1)\big]=30\;\text{m}\) yields \(t\approx3.62\;\text{s}\), and thus \(v=12.25(1-e^{-0.8\times3.62})\approx11.58\;\text{m/s}\).

Hume famously claims that reason is the “slave of the passions,” meaning it serves and is guided by our passions rather than directing them.

\(t = \frac{\ln\!\left[1+\frac{^{40}\!Ar}{^{40}\!K \times 0.1072}\right]}{\lambda}\)  

which evaluates to ≈ 6.8 × 10⁹ years.
